title: Shadow Shuriken Technique
body:
Syntax: perform shadow shuriken technique <target>

Description: A Ninjutsu jutsu, part of every character's starting kit. Ninjutsu requires the deliberate 'perform' command. 2-3 chakra damage (Wind element -- boosted or weakened by the room's biome), costs 8 Chakra, 2 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-08-17
